retainedQualifications: REED2-CAL-02-VERSION: Exact delivered PDF has King's portal cover, followed by 12 publisher pages; physical page equals printed page plus one. Portal labels version of record, publisher title page retains Published Online xxx placeholder and copyright 2025 while issue is February 2026. No external current-version check. New hash 093d differs from prior 42e4; prior acceptance does not transfer.

REED2-CAL-02-FAMILY: Economic evaluation explicitly alongside PAX-D, parent clinical report cited as Browning 2025 DOI 10.1016/S2215-0366(25)00194-4. Existing report B-R0112/F01 and aliases retained; no new independent trial or summed participants. Prior FAM-B-R0112 family claim preserved as provenance, not overwritten canonically.

REED2-CAL-02-DENOMINATORS: Economic report says 150 randomized (75/75); existing parent-trial metadata says 151 randomized/150 eligible. Current main paper does not adjudicate that difference. Main economic sample 124 (61/63) requires baseline/12-week data and is not all randomized participants despite ITT terminology. Complete-case 48-week sensitivity n56 is distinct.

REED2-CAL-02-MISSINGNESS: Later data imputed under missing-at-random, which authors say cannot be verified. Some later enrollees could not reach 48 weeks for administrative reasons. Complete-case sensitivity is less precise and less favorable; per-protocol excludes treatment discontinuers without another adherence threshold. Do not equate observed and imputed data or call 124 full 48-week completers.

REED2-CAL-02-ECONOMIC_UNITS: GBP at 2022/2023 price year, horizons 12 and 48 weeks and two perspectives. QALY/YFC/CWLY are integrated economic outcomes, not point utility changes, symptom remission or literal added survival. Capability WTP thresholds are borrowed theoretically, not established. No current price, reimbursement or access conclusion.

REED2-CAL-02-COST_CI: Societal 12-week cost difference Table 3 is 50.22 with CI -703.09 to 803.53; Table 4 is rounded 50 with CI -693 to 794. This difference exceeds ordinary integer rounding, remains unresolved. NHS 48-week cost CI lower bound is 109.82 in Table 3, 109 in Table 4 and 110 in abstract/body. Preserve each source literal without silent replacement.

REED2-CAL-02-ICER: Table 4 notes ICERs calculated from unrounded inputs. Do not recompute from rounded costs/effects. Negative 48-week societal ICER accompanies lower mean costs and positive mean QALYs, with cost CI crossing zero. Acceptability probability is conditional on perspective/horizon/WTP, not chance an individual benefits or proof of significant cost savings.

REED2-CAL-02-SECONDARY: Primary QALY probabilities exceed 90% at 20000 GBP in main NHS analyses, but secondary capability estimates are not uniformly so: 48-week NHS YFC 79% and CWLY 44%. CWLY ICER 21320 exceeds the borrowed 20000 threshold. Do not flatten all outcomes/scenarios into a greater-than-90% claim.

REED2-CAL-02-SENSITIVITY: Complete-case n56: QALY difference .038 CI -.050 to .126, ICER 20840 CI -166588 to 207354 and NHS 20000 GBP cost-effectiveness probability 54%, versus 93% main. Current-cost scenario is historical 2024/2025 with probabilities 82% to 96%, not a verified current price. Full appendix details unchecked.

REED2-CAL-02-NET_BENEFITS: Positive NMB and NHB point estimates have confidence intervals crossing zero. Main methods render the NHB formula as delta E minus (delta C lambda), unlike standard dimensional division; preserve the source typography and do not silently repair or adopt that expression. Threshold attribution of the reported NMB/NHB values is not explicit in the main results paragraph; do not assign an invented lambda.

REED2-CAL-02-HARMS: Economic report cites parent trial for adverse effects and 20% versus 5% stopping study medication, mostly intolerance in active arm. These are parent-trial context, not a fresh safety endpoint or exact event counts/denominators. Increased non-mental-health inpatient costs concentrated in one participant are stated not linked to serious treatment-related events, not evidence of no serious events.

REED2-CAL-02-REFERENCES: Introduction concludes PAX-D citation with reference 14, which is a QIDS instrument paper; main trial is reference 13 and protocol is reference 15. Lived-experience sentence cites reference 17, whose title is a different PReDicT trial. These citation mismatches are retained, not borrowed as independent results.

REED2-CAL-02-ACCESS_DISCLOSURES: Separate available supplement DOCX and old main PDF were hash-checked as metadata only; no companion content/SAP/protocol/registry/current integrity read. NIHR support and stated no funder role coexist with declared financial/nonfinancial interests of AJC/PJC/QJMH/ACL/NN/MB/JS. Participant data sharing is conditional on approved application, not public raw data.
